questions.question: Какую проблему MCP (Model Context Protocol) решает для AI agents?
options: Он задает standard format для training data
Он дает agents standard way to discover and use tools, exposed by external servers, without hardcoding tool implementations
Он encrypts communication between agents
Он сжимает large context windows для smaller models
questions.explanation: MCP standardizes tool access: server exposes tools with JSON schemas, а any MCP-compatible agent can discover and call them. Это decouples tool implementation from agent code.

questions.question: В чем разница между MCP и A2A?
options: MCP для Python agents, A2A для JavaScript agents
MCP connects agents to tools (agent-to-tool), while A2A connects agents to other agents (agent-to-agent) for task delegation
MCP синхронный, A2A asynchronous
MCP open source, A2A proprietary
questions.explanation: MCP -- protocol for tool access (agent calls a tool). A2A -- protocol for agent collaboration (agent delegates a task to another agent). Они решают разные layers communication problem.

questions.question: В A2A что такое 'agent card' и почему это важно?
options: Visual dashboard с agent performance metrics
JSON document at well-known URL, описывающий agent capabilities, skills и endpoint, позволяя other agents discover and delegate tasks
Security credential, который authenticates identity agent
Configuration file, задающий system prompt agent
questions.explanation: Agent card (hosted at /.well-known/agent.json) -- способ, которым agents advertise themselves. Он lists skills, supported input/output formats и task endpoint. Other agents read this card, чтобы решить, whether and how to delegate work.

questions.question: Почему multi-agent systems нужны structured communication protocols вместо простой передачи strings между agents?
options: Strings слишком большие для отправки over HTTP
Structured protocols дают type safety, discoverability, error handling и interoperability между agents, созданными разными teams with different frameworks
String parsing computationally expensive для LLM
Structured protocols required by all cloud providers
questions.explanation: Без structured contracts agents от разных teams misinterpret each other's output, error handling ad-hoc, и нет способа discover what another agent can do. Protocols дают shared language, делающий multi-agent systems reliable.

questions.question: Чем ACP (Agent Communication Protocol) отличается от A2A по design goals?
options: ACP faster than A2A for real-time applications
ACP фокусируется на enterprise auditability with full message history и compliance tracking, while A2A focuses on lightweight task delegation
ACP работает only within single organization, while A2A across organizations
ACP uses WebSockets while A2A uses HTTP
questions.explanation: ACP был designed for enterprise environments, где every agent interaction must be auditable, traceable and compliant. A2A проще и focuses on getting tasks done. ACP adds governance layer, required by regulated industries.
